values.name: resampler Xoff
values.value: trunc((Nmult + 1) x 0.5 x max(1, 1/factor) + 10) = 55 (Nmult 65)

values.name: resampler history
values.value: X of 0x2800 bytes (5120 samples) zeroed at creation; every call reads its input from the start into X[Xoff..4096]; after a pass X[i] = X[i + Nx] for Xoff - Nx + 4096 samples, Nx = whole samples Time moved (16-bit), next read at 4096 - Nx; Time = Xoff << 15 on the first call only
values.source: 0x1001c6d0 (0x1001c78a, memset 0x1001c807), readData 0x1001c030 (position +0x38), 0x1001c5b2-0x1001c6aa, first-call flag +0x2c cleared at 0x1001c9ea

values.name: resampler output queue
values.value: each phone chunk is owed floor(n x factor) outputs and handed on first in first out once they are made
values.source: chunk +0xc set at 0x1002904a; queue 0x10023e20 (add 0x10023e80, outputs 0x10023ec0, pop 0x10024010 / 0x10023f20 with ELQBufferPop slot 0x100b74a8)

values.name: resampler phrase flush
values.value: at a phrase's end, with input waiting: one more call with the flag set, every phone still owed gets at most what is made (ELQBufferPopForced), the rest is dropped (ELQBufferClean), the input is dropped; X and Time carry on; a new utterance makes a new state
